description: This file is a shell script used for testing various aspects of Git fetch-pack functionality, including clone operations, shallow clones, ref handling, protocol negotiations, and filtering mechanisms. It contains functions for setting up repositories, performing fetch operations, and verifying behaviors through scripted tests.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Function to add a commit with specified name and message, creating a new branch and updating refs accordingly.

methods.name: pull_to_client
methods.description: Function to perform a fetch operation from a server to a client repository and verify the object count.

methods.name: check_prot_path
methods.description: Function to verify protocol URL diagnostics with specified URL components.

methods.name: check_prot_host_port_path
methods.description: Function to verify protocol URL diagnostics with host, port, protocol, and path.
